Trials.Name: Compact depth intervals with tile shared ballot

Result.Geometry: Static projected triangles with interpolated UV and normals; colored screen/view-depth decal projectors
Result.Material: Shared 64x64 RGBA pattern, interpolated normals, diffuse and specular lighting for occluded Xray; textured color decals after opaque shading
Result.Cluster: 16x16 XY tiles, 32 logarithmic view-depth slices; 4-byte slice interval per item; source-order candidate masks generated by wave ballots
Result.Timing: GPU timestamps include barriers, shading and blending; Cluster also refreshes all depth intervals each frame. ClusterCached builds intervals during static setup. Common background and static projected geometry/XY reference construction precede timing
Result.Memory: Explicit effect data, uniforms and cell masks; common opaque color/depth are inputs
